article.title: Louisville and Syracuse meet in ACC action
article.linkText: Louisville and Syracuse meet in ACC action
article.story: Louisville (3-3) at Syracuse (2-3), Oct. 17 at 7:30 p.m. EDT. Opening Line: Louisville by 12.5. Against the spread: Louisville 4-2, Syracuse 2-3. How to watch: ACC Network Key stats Louisville Offense Overall: 494.5 yards per game (10th in FBS) Passing: 262.8 yards per game (36th) Rushing: 231.7 yards per game (11th) Scoring: 39.5 points per game (16th) Louisville Defense Overall: 412.8 yards per game (123rd in FBS) Passing: 257.2 yards per game (123rd) Rushing: 155.7 yards per game (91st) Scoring: 27.7 points per game (103rd) Syracuse Offense Overall: 447.2 yards per game (37th in FBS) Passing: 281.4 yards per game (20th) Rushing: 165.8 yards per game (59th) Scoring: 32.8 points per game (52nd) Syracuse Defense Overall: 312.6 yards per game (34th in FBS) Passing: 168.2 yards per game (22nd) Rushing: 144.4 yards per game (76th) Scoring: 24.0 points per game (74th) Syracuse is 77th in the FBS with a -1 turnover margin, compared to Louisville's 15th-ranked +5 margin. Both teams are heavily penalized. Louisville ranks 126th in the FBS averaging 74.5 penalty yards per game, and Syracuse ranks 138th with a 100.0-yard average. Louisville is 97th in FBS in red zone offense, scoring on 81.8% of trips. Syracuse's red zone defense ranks 32nd at 76.5%. Louisville ranks 95th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 28:51, compared to Syracuse's 5th-ranked average of 34:18. Team leaders Louisville Passing: Lincoln Kienholz, 1,534 yards, 9 TDs, 1 INT, 69.5 completion percentage Rushing: Isaac Brown, 557 yards on 74 carries, 4 TDs Receiving: Tre Richardson, 445 yards on 29 catches, 2 TDs Syracuse Passing: Steve Angeli, 730 yards, 4 TDs, 5 INTs, 55.3 completion percentage Rushing: Tylik Hill, 405 yards on 69 carries, 1 TD Receiving: Umari Hatcher, 560 yards on 37 catches, 6 TDs Last game Louisville won 44-20 over Florida State on Oct. 9. Kienholz led Louisville with 140 yards on 11-of-15 passing (73.3%) for no touchdowns and no interceptions. He also carried the ball nine times for 40 yards and two rushing touchdowns. Brown carried the ball 17 times for 235 yards and scored two touchdowns, adding one reception for seven yards. Lawayne McCoy recorded 78 yards on three catches. Syracuse fell 28-25 to Virginia on Oct. 10. Malachi Nelson threw for 217 yards on 16-of-29 attempts (55.2%) with one touchdown and no interceptions. Hill had 118 rushing yards on 23 carries. Hatcher had eight receptions for 126 yards and one touchdown. Next game Louisville hosts Stanford on Oct. 31. Syracuse plays at North Carolina on Oct. 24.
